verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents first-party realm import/export as JSON files and separate export of authorization configuration, so data can leave in an open, machine-readable format. The Admin REST API and the kcadm.sh CLI also give scripted access to realms, users, roles and clients. The evidence does not show that a realm export covers all data (users, credentials, sessions), and no hands-on report confirms a successful migration out. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that exports include users and credential hashes, a documented full-tenant exit or migration path, independent corroboration of leaving via export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
